plate_comment: The A/C clutch control dispatcher (e2m 8A14 +4 AC_Control_Configuration: 0 = BR truck - 1 = DR truck): runs the BR or the DR truck algorithm; the dump holds 1 (DR) (was hpcr_fuel_mode_state_transition)
A/C clutch algorithm 0 (BR truck): a gate on engine speed - the A/C switch and the A/C pressure (was engine_protection_fuelMass_rpmCheck)

A/C clutch algorithm 1 (DR truck): condition codes 1-15 - cycle on / off times - the low rpm and high pressure thresholds; sets logical output 0x26 (the A/C clutch request) (was engine_protection_conditionCode_evaluate)

Integrates the change of the engine speed / vehicle speed ratio (cruise_rpm_ratio_ema) into cruise_rpm_ratio_integral - not a speed error; the clutch cutout uses it (was governor_cruise_speedError_integrate)
Stores the initial PCI (J1850) message status bytes: 37 of the 40 descriptor entries and the spare message $16; no J1939 buffer (was hpcr_initJ1939BufferValues)
The persistence counters of the TPU-A channel 2 / 7 flags: end of injection limit exceeded and injection command overlap (e2m 804A / 804B; faults 325 / 326) (was cm848_updateEngineStatusTimers)

Debounces and latches the accelerator pedal idle validation faults (P2121 fault 63 - P2127 fault 62 - P2128 fault 68) and saves the idle validation switch state at a throttle validation error; no fuel demand smoothing (was cm848_fuelDemandSmoothingController)
Sensor channel 54 wrapper run every pass from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs: the injector driver booster capacitor 1 voltage (faults 328 / 329; P2146) (was cm848_initProtectionParameter1)
Sensor channel 54 wrapper run once at boot from cm848_applicationMain: the booster capacitor 1 voltage (was cm848_processProtectionParameter1)
Sensor channel 55 wrapper run every pass from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs: the injector driver booster capacitor 2 voltage (faults 330 / 331; P2149) (was cm848_initProtectionParameter2)
Sensor channel 55 wrapper run once at boot from cm848_applicationMain: the booster capacitor 2 voltage (was cm848_processProtectionParameter2)

Loads the injector driver calibration (every value is an e2m 8041 record): the MIOS PWM 16-19 periods and levels (booster / recharge voltage - hold / pull-in current) and the TPU-A channel 14 recharge current period (was cm848_tpuMiosOutput_loadCalibration) | earlier note: loads TPU-A CH14/CH10 params + MIOS MPWMSM PWM outputs 16-19 from calibration values (no threshold check despite old name); physical actuator per output unknown - see docs/tpu_mios_channel_map.md. Renamed from cm848_protection_threshold_calib_check
